A.label: VISUAL_OBSERVATION
A.registered_definition: Visual observation of plants, habitat, and naturally occurring interactions without touching, manipulating, measuring, marking, or collecting plant material.

B.label: PHOTOGRAPHY_MORPHOLOGY_DOCUMENTATION
B.registered_definition: Photography of whole plants, diagnostic leaf-whorl characters, petiole/bract bases, flowers, habitat, and other morphology without removing plant material.

C.label: NON_DESTRUCTIVE_MEASUREMENT
C.registered_definition: Non-destructive measurements and natural-history observations, including focal-flower timing, flower counts, morphology measurements that do not remove tissue, visitation observation, early predator/oviposition evidence, and water-state assessment.

D.label: VOUCHER_SPECIMEN_COLLECTION
D.registered_definition: Collection of a limited voucher specimen for taxonomic documentation, only when separately authorized.

E.label: LEAF_OR_TISSUE_SAMPLING
E.registered_definition: Collection of a limited amount of leaf or other plant tissue for laboratory or genetic analysis, only when separately authorized.

F.label: SEED_OR_FRUIT_COLLECTION
F.registered_definition: Collection of a limited amount of seed or fruit material, only when separately authorized.
